To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

ovomucoid exists as multiple variants differing in their carbohydrate content, that these variants are present in the egg white of all birds studied, that these variants differ in their charge and in the extent of their glycosylation but have closely similar amino acid compositions and trypsin-inhibition activities, and that these variants are synthesized by the oviduct.
ovomucoid exists as a number of variants differing in carbohydrate content and that the charge heterogeneity is related, in part to the variation in sialylation.
the carbohydrate composition of the major species of ovomudoid is different, and that charge heterogeneity of ovomudoids is related to variation in sialoglycopeptide content.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and characterization of the major glycoproteins in egg-white and their relationship to the biological properties of this material.
the structure and function, particularly the enzymic activity, of ovomucoids from different sources.
the isolation and characterization of ovomucoids and their carbohydrate components and with the elucidation of the role of ovomucoidal carbohydrate in the function of the protein.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the carbohydrate moiety is a variable component in ovomucoid.
there is no evidence to suggest any functional differences between the various forms of ovomucoids.
ovomucoid is not a single entity but a group of proteins that differ in carbohydrate content and charge but have closely similar trypin inhibitory activity and immunochemical properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
carbohydrate is not essential for the biological activity of ovomucoids.
ovomucoid has a highly complex carbohydrate composition, and that this is related to the presence of multiple charge forms.
carbohydrate is a minor component of ovomucoids, and that it is not involved in the binding of ovomucoidal protein to trypsin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ovomucoid is a complex protein with a variety of different carbohydrate moieties that can be isolated and analyzed.
ovomucoid is a highly glycosylated protein with variable carbohydrate composition.
ovomucoid is a highly variable protein, and the variation is not random.
